title: Search less, generalize more: overfitting-aware evolutionary feature selection for radiomics (code and results)
description: Code, pre-registration, run files and results of a pre-registered benchmark of wrapper feature selection for radiomics: 12 searchers and 4 generalization controls on 43 public radMLBench datasets (12 development, 31 confirmation). Code under the MIT licence; run files, analysis outputs, figures and tables under CC BY 4.0. The underlying datasets keep their own licences.
